title.narrative: Kamer: An Opportunity for Every Woman 2022-2023
Kamer: En Möjlighet för Varje Kvinna 2022 - 2023

description.narrative: Målet med projektet är att skapa ett samhälle med ett ökande antal bemyndigade kvinnor som står upp mot våld som aktiva deltagare i samhället.

The objective of the project is to create a society with increasing number of empowered women standing up against violence as active participants of the society. To achieve this objective, the project has the following outcomes: Outcome 1 KAMER, as an effective, powerful, and qualified organization strengthened its impact on the field and political processes. Outcome 2 Women’s attitude towards violence and their rights has changed and they have become active participants in society (including migrant, disabled women and LGBTQI+ individuals) Outcome 3 Women are empowered in their struggle against violence and honor crimes. Outcome 4 Public administration, men, NGOs, and the society started to take initiative related to promoting women’s human rights and gender equality.
Women are empowered in their struggle against violence and honor crimes. Women's attitude towards violence and their rights has changed and become active participants in society

sector.narrative: Ending violence against women and girls

description.narrative:
An Opportunity for Every Woman project continues to be relevant for addressing issues related to gender equality and poverty in Southeast and East Turkiye. KAMER has continually adjusted its objectives and approach to changing circumstances, including natural disasters, the Syrian refugee crisis, and the 2023 earthquake.
KAMER has been successful in meeting its objectives. It exceeded planned targets in some areas, such as collaboration with NGOs, organising climate meetings and enabling access to justice.
The organisation has empowered women through various methods, enhancing their awareness, skills and ability to assert their rights.
KAMER has also bolstered its influence in the field and within political processes. KAMER has a clear impact on the individual and community levels.
